items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And I got him and Joe Thomas, who was Walter Thomas' brother, to come up from there to play with the Virginia Ravens.

ctx.x: And while I was in Milwaukee, one day I was walking down to the place called the Metropole there, where the musicians hung out. And I walked down there and there was the Virginia Ravens' bus. So I walked over and the guys was glad to see me and they gave me my job back. So I went on back with them and I stayed -- we played around there with them all -- somewhere up in Wisconsin, Eau Claire and Black River Falls and all that. And finally they needed a trumpet player. Well, I found this boy, Leroy White, he was…

Jameson's band down in Wichita. And I got him and Joe Thomas, who was Walter Thomas' brother, to come up from there to play with the Virginia Ravens. And then also Merle Williams was home, he came back with the Virginia Ravens.
Now, this is Joe Thomas the tenor player?

items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Tremendous trumpet player. And, Eddie Barefield.

ctx.x: Anyone else in that well-known besides you and George?
Yeah. Sure. Fellows like I'm selfish with the trumpets, you know.
